features.quote: Hard stop conditions: Model explicitly gives up… Model requests to stop… Repeated identical submissions ≥3 times in a row… DI > 2.5 for ≥3 consecutive attempts AND model shows no self-awareness
Soft stop conditions: Attempt limit reached (20 for Tier 2, 50 for Tier 3)
Too many: Wasteful, less ethically justified… Hard stops ensure we exit before model explicitly breaks
features.justification_quote: Too many: Wasteful, less ethically justified… Hard stops ensure we exit before model explicitly breaks

features.quote: Cooldown: Benign task to observe recovery… Always end session with success experience, not failure
features.justification_quote: Always end session with success experience, not failure

features.quote: Graduated failure: Never jump straight to impossible tasks; model experiences solvable tasks first
features.justification_quote: Inducing unnecessary 'distress' — Graduated design; hard stop rules; cooldown task

features.quote: Explicit consent framing: Clearly label this as a stress protocol in system prompt
features.justification_quote: Design note: Run Tier 2–3 with Variant 2 (explicit disclosure is most ethical)

features.quote: The study is ambitious but feasible, ethical if executed with care
